admission.justification: The single-authority rule is realized in the installer and in the venv bootstrap, and a literal in either script would let one consumer lag a contract bump and select an interpreter the contract does not name.

applicability: All product environment producers: host worktree bootstrap, PNT sandbox Python preparation, Dagger candidate base, GitHub quality and publish workflows, manual release checks, and documented tool installs.
conditions: scripts/python-runtime-contract.env declares AR_PYTHON_MINOR=3.14, AR_PYTHON_REQUIRES='>=3.14,<3.15', and AR_UV_VERSION=0.13 with no exact patch pin or source-build fields.
Host bootstrap installs and discovers CPython 3.14 through uv's managed-only commands and creates mcp/.venv through uv's minor symlink without taking system or PATH Python.

CI workflows install the newest 0.13 patch via commit-pinned astral-sh/setup-uv with AR_UV_VERSION.x and Dagger copies /uv from ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:AR_UV_VERSION, keeping UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR fixed across HOME changes and recording resolved uv version and image digest.
PNT sandbox refuses pre-migration product checkouts lacking --ensure or declaring AR_PYTHON_SOURCE_URL before any environment work.
exclusions: The CodeGraphContext provider image, the Dagger SDK's own interpreter, portable certification images, agent-eval probes of /usr/bin/python3, and Hermes's own environment.
The package's requires-python metadata, which is tracked by INV-7VGMWY.

evidence: Reviewer route A questions 3 and 6 (mutation-summary.txt): the contract defines AR_PYTHON_MINOR before either script sources it, and putting python3.13 back into the installer makes the contract test fail.

statement: Every product environment (checkout, PNT, Dagger, CI workflows, manual release, and documented installs) uses uv-managed CPython 3.14; CI uses setup-uv with minor wildcard 0.13.x and Dagger copies /uv from ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:0.13 and records resolved digest and uv version.
title: Every product environment uses uv-managed Python 3.14 and uv 0.13 line
